messages:
Priya: Heads-up  noticed a batch of Stripe webhooks arrived out-of-order overnight and our importer applied them in the wrong sequence. That produced mismatched invoice states and duplicate ledger entries for 11 customers. NetSuite reports SEQUENCE_CONFLICT on the re-imports.

billing-bot: webhook-consumer: batch-4987 processed 2026-06-12 02:12 UTC - 11 sequence_gap events detected, 7 processed out-of-order, 4 moved to dlq.

Diego: I pulled the webhook delivery log. Stripe retried webhook deliveries with backoff but some deliveries hit different consumer instances during a deploy window; our local at-least-once handler applied event A (invoice.updated) before event B (invoice.created) due to replay ordering not preserved. The idempotency key existed only for create, not updates.

Sam: That explains duplicate ledger entries. Our importer assumes monotonic event sequence per invoice id, but we rely on delivery ordering from the queue which is not guaranteed across partitions. We should enforce per-invoice sequence checks at ingestion.

Marta: Quick product note: this started after last night's consumer autoscale where new pods joined and processed older retry deliveries. There's also a subtle bug: the dedupe cache TTL is 5 minutes but Stripe retries can span >1h, so dedupe missed some replays.

Priya: Finance: we have 11 impacted invoices on hold. We need a remediation plan to correct ledger entries and re-sync with NetSuite. Customers may see invoice status flapping. Created TICKET-4422: "Webhook sequence gap caused duplicate ledger entries & NetSuite rejections".

Diego: Hotfix plan: 1) Add a per-invoice sequence token check to webhook-consumer: persist last_applied_sequence in redis and reject/apply only if incoming_seq > last_applied_seq. 2) Extend dedupe cache TTL to 24h for invoice events and include event type in the idempotency key. 3) Add an exactly-once reconcile path for replays that hits a queue partitioned by invoice id.

Sam: I'll prepare a canary with the sequence token enforcement and TTL bump. Also we need to surface mismatches in a reconciliation report so finance can see which ledger entries were duplicates.

Marta: Ops action: pause consumer autoscale for the next hour and drain the retry queue into a quarantined stream so we can inspect ordering. I've paused the autoscaler and moved retry messages to webhook-retry-quarantine-2026-06-12.

ops-bot: autoscaler disabled: webhook-consumer-asg by Marta. retry messages moved: webhook-retry-quarantine-2026-06-12 (11 messages).

Diego: For remediation of ledger entries: we'll run a dedupe detection job that finds ledger lines with same stripe invoice id, same effective_date, and near-equal amounts, then flag for accounting review. We'll also generate a NetSuite re-sync plan to delete duplicates or create offsetting entries depending on NS acceptance.

Priya: Finance will review the dedupe report. For high-value customers (top 3) we'll do manual journal reversals today. For the rest, approve automated re-sync with reconciliation entries after ops confirms idempotency safeguards.

Sam: Canary deployed. Sequence check prevented 9 out-of-order applies in canary sample, TTL change in place. Adding an integration test that replays events in random order and expects final ledger parity with single-ordered delivery.

Marta: Once canary metrics look good, we'll run the dedupe detection dry-run and attach CSV to TICKET-4422. Please don't re-enable autoscale until sequence enforcement is in prod.

Priya: Thanks. Also flagging CS: if customers report duplicated invoices or payment retries, escalate to me. Will update TICKET-4422 with finance decisions after reviewing the dry-run.

Diego: Follow-ups: 1) add persistent per-invoice sequence state + safe tombstone policy, 2) increase dedupe TTL and tighten idempotency keys, 3) partition retry processing by invoice id for replay safety, 4) add a monitoring alert: >5 sequence gap events in a run auto-quarantines the retry topic.

Sam: Postmortem scheduled tomorrow. Will include rollout checklist for autoscale changes and an integration test for out-of-order webhooks.

Priya: Good work catching this early. :white_check_mark:
